Someone had</text><text x="30" y="402" font-family="Liberation Serif, Georgia, serif" font-size="17" fill="#6d6475">written her name.</text><text x="30" y="456" font-family="Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10.5" fill="#a59a8a" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="1.5">AUTHORIAL INTERPRETATION</text><text x="30" y="478" font-family="Liberation Serif, Georgia, serif" font-size="17" fill="#6d6475">Maya had always been careful.</text></svg>
